import shutil
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


def _record_archive_entry(target_dir: Path, filename: str) -> None:
    # Append an entry to an archive manifest in the archive directory
    manifest = target_dir / "archive_manifest.json"
    entries = json.loads(manifest.read_text()) if manifest.exists() else []
    entries.append({
        "file": filename,
        "archived_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    })
    manifest.write_text(json.dumps(entries, indent=2))


def move_backup_to_archive(backup_filename: str, backup_dir: str, archive_dir: str) -> str:
    source_path = Path(backup_dir) / Path(backup_filename).name
    target_dir = Path(archive_dir)
    target_path = target_dir / source_path.name
    moved = shutil.move(str(source_path), str(target_path))
    _record_archive_entry(target_dir, source_path.name)
    return str(moved)
